title: React Native apps
description: For a React Native app: no secret in the app bundle, tokens in the platform's secure storage, nothing sensitive in deep links, HTTPS endpoints and upgrades through the Upgrade Helper; builds on the react pack.

sources.title: React Native docs, upgrading to new versions

rules.instruction: Never put an API key or a secret in the app's code or in variables that react-native-config or react-native-dotenv build into it: anyone who inspects the bundle can read them. Call a server or a function that holds the secret and forwards the request instead.
rules.verification: Review the files and environment variables the change adds to the app and check that none holds a key or a secret meant for a server.

rules.instruction: Store tokens, passwords and other secrets in the platform's secure storage (iOS Keychain Services, Android Keystore or Encrypted Shared Preferences, for example through expo-secure-store or react-native-keychain), never in Async Storage, which is unencrypted.
rules.verification: Search the change for `AsyncStorage` and check that no token or secret is written through it.

rules.instruction: Send no token or other sensitive data in a deep link: another app can register the same scheme and receive it. Use universal links to open content of the app on iOS.
rules.verification: Review the links the change builds or handles and check that none carries a token or personal data.

rules.instruction: Call the app's APIs over `https://` only. When the app pins certificates, plan the update of the pinned certificates before the server's certificate expires, or the published app stops working.
rules.verification: Check that the API addresses the change adds start with `https://`, and, when the app pins certificates, that the expiry date and the release that replaces them are recorded.

rules.instruction: Upgrade React Native with the Upgrade Helper: install the `react-native` and `react` versions it shows, then apply the changes it lists to the Android, iOS and JavaScript project files. An Expo app upgrades through the Expo SDK instead.
rules.verification: Compare the change with the Upgrade Helper diff between the two versions and check that each listed project file was updated, then build the app on Android and iOS.
